title: Liquid Stress
description: Solo-developed and shipped a productivity desktop suite to Steam, achieving 95.5K impressions, 24K visits, a 14.5% click-through rate, and 300+ downloads with no marketing budget. Architected a PyQt5 GUI with customizable timers, bar graph and pie chart analytics, OS-level goal overlays with progress bars, and hand-animated 3D Blender assets — optimized for minimal CPU footprint.

title: Cosmic Portfolio
tech: Next.js, React, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Vercel
description: Built a full-stack developer portfolio where projects appear as navigable stars inside a Three.js galaxy, featuring custom GLSL shaders, post-processing effects, and dynamic scene generation driven by a PostgreSQL database. Implemented a secure admin panel for live project management, integrated Drizzle ORM for database access, and deployed on Vercel via Next.js App Router — with all 3D assets modeled in Blender.

title: SEC Financial Fund Scraper
tech: Python, Playwright, Async I/O, CSV Pipeline
description: Built a headless Playwright automation tool to crawl 77,000+ pages on adviserinfo.sec.gov, with automatic retry logic, rate-limit backoff, and resume-safe CSV deduplication. Parsed and normalized JSON API responses into structured datasets enabling recruiters to cross-reference candidate employment history against top-tier financial institutions.
